acceptance_criteria.ac_3_legacy_fields_restored: id, outcome, status, state are projected as before 224b60032 (status/state pending for proposed/under_review); owner-supplied keys still override as before.
acceptance_criteria.ac_4_tests: test_approval_projection_invents_nothing_and_keeps_legacy_fields asserts null/absent values for a bare owner record and both old and new fields.

test_pkt006_approval_queue_contract:test.description: Exact-match expected item gains id, outcome, status, state because AC3 of this task restores the pre-224b60032 projected fields. No existing expected value was removed or weakened.

note: required_deciders for capital/rebalance increase targets (services/governance/approval_targets.py) is not re-derived in the BFF; required_approvals is passed through only when the owner supplies it.
